answer: Sybil resistance can be a bonded attestation levy peers recompute from chain state. Each new address deposits 50 POA that pays 2 POA to every established attestor who verifies one unique epoch nonce for that address; eligibility requires 12 distinct paid attestors in the current establishment window. A sockpuppet must fund a separate 50 POA pot, because receipts are keyed to one address and a reused nonce is rejected. The levy, receipts, and remaining bond are public, so multiplying identities has an explicit signal—clear as a quill stroke, and as hard to fake as a tide gauge on the ocean.
